speech.heard: In the USA, 97.6% of people have safe drinking water, in Chad, just 6.3%. Central African Republic has 6.2%, the world's lowest, far below the USA. To count as safe, water must be accessible on premises, available when needed and free from fecal and priority chemical contamination. Ranked above the USA, Hungary has 100%, Germany has 99.9%, and the UK has 99.8%. Trailing behind the USA, India has 76.4% while Nigeria has 29.9%. Does safe drinking water flow straight from your tap?
